name: DriveSQ Instructor Dashboard
description:
DriveSQ Instructor Dashboard is the dedicated management app for DriveSQ driving instructors across Greater Manchester.

Built exclusively for ADIs and PDIs working with DriveSQ, the portal gives you everything you need to manage your teaching business in one place.

FEATURES:
• View and manage your pupil list
• Track lesson bookings and availability
• Monitor pupil progress and lesson notes
• Communicate with DriveSQ management
• Access your instructor dashboard instantly

Secure login — your data is protected and only accessible to you.

For DriveSQ instructors only. To join the DriveSQ instructor team, visit www.drivesq.co.uk or WhatsApp 07352 932003.

DriveSQ — Manchester's #1 DVSA-approved driving school. 90%+ first-time pass rate. 5/5 on Google.
